metadata.verificationPolicy: Conservative program-fit copy with official source URLs — not employment ranking claims.

insights.headline: Strong accountancy value at a public SUC
insights.body: PUP Manila is widely known for BS Accountancy and attracts students who want CPA-track training without elite private tuition. RA 10931 free tuition can apply for eligible enrollees, and the OSFA also runs merit and work-study programs.

insights.headline: Accessible CS and business analytics path
insights.body: PUP offers BS Computer Science and business programs that build spreadsheet, coding, and research skills used in analyst roles. Graduates often enter NCR IT, BPO analytics, and government data teams — a practical route if you want technical training on a public-university budget.

insights.headline: Large IT graduate pipeline
insights.body: PUP Manila produces many IT and computer science graduates who join software teams, startups, and enterprise IT departments in Metro Manila. The campus culture rewards builders and problem-solvers who learn by doing.

insights.headline: Business programs with real-world hustle
insights.body: BS Business Administration and related tracks at PUP attract students who want to learn sales, operations, and small-business skills without heavy upfront cost — a common starting point for young founders and family-business successors.

insights.headline: Engineering and CS reputation
insights.body: DLSU is known for computer science and engineering rigor, industry partnerships, and a strong recruiting presence from tech employers. A good fit if you want structured STEM training plus campus networks that feed software roles.

insights.headline: Established engineering college
insights.body: De La Salle's engineering programs emphasize design, labs, and project work that map directly to mechanical and manufacturing careers. Scholarship grants like St. La Salle Financial Assistance can offset cost for qualified students.

insights.headline: Management and leadership formation
insights.body: Ateneo's management programs emphasize ethics, teamwork, and presentation skills that translate well to startups, family ventures, and corporate leadership tracks. Financial aid and merit programs can reduce tuition for qualified applicants.

insights.headline: Psychology and human sciences depth
insights.body: Ateneo offers psychology and related liberal arts training with research and service culture — a common path for students aiming at counseling, HR, or graduate psychology programs.

insights.headline: Education and formation focus
insights.body: Ateneo trains educators who value mentorship and community impact. Education-related programs and service learning align with students who want to teach, coach, or lead learning programs.

insights.headline: Historic health sciences campus
insights.body: FEU Manila is long known for nursing and allied health programs with clinical training pipelines. If patient care and hospital work appeal to you, FEU is a traditional NCR choice with merit and aid options.

insights.headline: Arts and multimedia exposure
insights.body: FEU offers arts, communication, and design-adjacent programs suited to students who want visual storytelling, branding, or creative industry work after college.

insights.headline: Philippines' national polytechnic
insights.body: PUP Manila delivers accessible quality programs in business, IT, and engineering — especially attractive if you want strong training with RA 10931 free tuition eligibility and OSFA scholarships.

insights.headline: Research-oriented Lasallian university
insights.body: DLSU is known for business, engineering, and technology programs with industry ties across Metro Manila.

insights.headline: Jesuit university in Quezon City
insights.body: Ateneo emphasizes liberal arts, management, leadership, and service — with scholarship programs for merit and financial need.

insights.headline: Manila university with health and business strength
insights.body: FEU combines health sciences, business, and arts programs on a central Manila campus.
